# Getting help

1. **Run `codex-imagegen-mcp doctor`.** It checks Node, credentials, backend reachability and quota, the sign-in ports and every tool it's installed in, and usually names the fix. `codex-imagegen-mcp install --list` shows which tools it detects and where imagegen is installed.
2. **Read the docs.** [Troubleshooting](../README.md#troubleshooting), [Authentication](../docs/AUTH.md#troubleshooting) and [Tools → Errors](../docs/TOOLS.md#errors) cover the common problems.
3. **Ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/ShalomObongo/codex-imagegen-mcp/discussions)** for questions, ideas and setups that aren't bugs.
4. **Open an [issue](https://github.com/ShalomObongo/codex-imagegen-mcp/issues/new/choose)** for bugs, with the output of `doctor`.

Never post tokens or the contents of any `auth.json`. Security issues go through [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

This is an unofficial project, not affiliated with OpenAI. OpenAI's support can't help with it, but your ChatGPT plan's usage limits and account questions are theirs.
